title: Sarvam AI Becomes Unicorn: $234M Funding Validates India-First AI
description: Sarvam AI secured $234 million, led by HCLTech, achieving unicorn status. This validates the 'India-first' AI stack as a critical, accelerating necessity for foundational innovation.

title: KPMG's AI Report Pulled: Hallucinations Underscore Human Oversight Need
description: KPMG withdrew its 'Redefining excellence in the age of agentic AI' report after major entities refuted its claims. This highlights the critical need for human oversight in AI-powered professional services to prevent reputational damage.

title: Anthropic Model Suspension: India's AI Sovereignty Crisis
description: Anthropic's U.S. government-mandated model suspension reveals India's over-reliance on foreign AI infrastructure, signaling a critical need for domestic AI sovereignty.

title: Anthropic Survey: Over Half of Americans Fear AI Job, Thinking Loss
description: Anthropic's 'Public Record' survey of 52,000 Americans reveals over half fear losing jobs and independent thinking to AI, highlighting a critical trust gap for builders.

title: California Privacy Law: Widespread Non-Compliance at 'Industrial Scale'
description: A Markup survey found widespread non-compliance with California's CCPA and CPRA at an 'industrial scale', revealing weak enforcement allows systemic disregard for user data protection.

title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed Hits 1000 TPS: What it Means
description: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed achieves 1000 tokens/second on a 1-trillion-parameter model, fundamentally shifting real-time AI interaction expectations.
